fields.name: Date Palm
fields.about: The date palm is a flowering tree in the palm family, cultivated for its sweet edible fruit. It is one of the oldest cultivated trees in the Arabian Peninsula.
fields.used_for: Its fruit (dates) is eaten fresh or dried, its leaves are used for weaving baskets and mats, and its trunk is used in construction.

fields.name: Olive Tree
fields.about: The olive is a small evergreen tree native to the Mediterranean region, known for living for hundreds of years.
fields.used_for: Its fruit is eaten pickled and pressed to make olive oil, and its wood is used for furniture and crafts.

fields.name: Mango
fields.about: The mango is a juicy tropical stone fruit native to South Asia, known as the "king of fruits".
fields.used_for: Eaten fresh, and used in juices, smoothies, desserts and chutneys.

fields.name: Strawberry
fields.about: The strawberry is a small flowering plant that produces sweet red fruit with seeds on its surface.
fields.used_for: Eaten fresh, and used in jams, desserts, juices and ice cream.

fields.name: Tomato
fields.about: The tomato is a plant from the nightshade family, originating in South America. Its red fruit is one of the most used foods in the world.
fields.used_for: Used in salads, sauces, soups and cooking.

fields.name: Carrot
fields.about: The carrot is a root vegetable, usually orange, rich in beta-carotene and vitamin A.
fields.used_for: Eaten raw in salads, cooked in meals, and used in juices and cakes.

fields.name: Mint
fields.about: Mint is an aromatic herb with a fresh, cool flavor, which grows quickly in moist soil.
fields.used_for: Added to tea and drinks, used in salads and cooking, and in some medicines.

fields.name: Lavender
fields.about: Lavender is a flowering plant from the mint family, famous for its purple flowers and calming scent.
fields.used_for: Used in perfumes, soaps, essential oils and as a decorative garden plant.

fields.name: Rose
fields.about: The rose is a flowering shrub known for its beautiful, fragrant flowers, and Taif in Saudi Arabia is famous for its roses.
fields.used_for: Used for decoration, gifts, perfumes and rose water.

fields.name: Aloe Vera
fields.about: Aloe vera is a succulent plant with thick, fleshy leaves that store water, and it grows well in dry climates.
fields.used_for: Its gel is used in skin care, to soothe burns, and in cosmetics.
